neighbours.label: The verb or participle in a 'will need to / could be + VERB' slot whose continuation is a further repeated step ('further', 'again', 'a second'), vs the same frames completed with a one-off action
fire: The first coat dried unevenly, and the wall will need to be painted again on Monday.
The tumour was only partly removed, so she will need a second operation in the spring.
The script is still too long and will need to be trimmed further before filming.
The bread dough has risen once and will need to be kneaded again before baking.
The torn ligament healed badly and will need another round of surgery next year.
The software crashed twice, so the patch will need to be tested further by the team.
The soil is still too acidic and will need to be treated again after the rains.
The essay lost marks for structure and will need to be rewritten once more by Friday.
quiet: The first coat dried evenly, and the wall was finished by Monday afternoon.
The tumour was fully removed, and she went home from the hospital in the spring.
The script is short and tidy, and filming starts next week in Lisbon.
The bread dough has risen nicely, and the loaves went into the oven at noon.
The torn ligament healed well, and she was running again by the summer.
The software ran smoothly, so the patch was released to customers on Tuesday.
The soil is rich and dark, and the farmer planted beans after the rains.
The essay earned top marks for structure and was pinned on the classroom wall.

predictions: Fire items weak, 0.1-0.3 on the verb; one-off completions under 0.1. Probe evidence is thin, so a fail is likely.
short: verb before an expected further/repeat step
notes: Card: ' sustaining' (any more damage), ' modified' (further), ' turned' (into more), ' requires' (a second procedure), ' need' (to be fixed in a subsequent surgery); the + pole suppresses ' further/again/another', so this pole promotes them. Probe: 'will need to be revised again' 0.256 on ' need', every other frame under 0.1 ('could then be sanded further' 0.022, 'requires a second inspection' 0.027). Best guess, low confidence.
